edges.note: Gerb's account has the CIA shutting Kona Blue down. Recorded here as an alleged act of the concealment apparatus rather than as an adjudicated fact.

edges.note: Gerb described Kona Blue to Coulthart as a DHS-brokered program in which Lockheed Martin material was reportedly diverted before the CIA shut it down.
